cross_cutting_finding.headline: Both G18 Mondays flipped UP against the blind's down; both were COVERING / BUY-ABSORPTION discharges the blind mis-read as spent.
cross_cutting_finding.mechanism: On BOTH seams the weekend inherited buy-side pressure that the blind (and E) classified as 'absorbed/spent and done' and subordinated to a down chain - but it discharged UP Monday. 0427: covering demand (big prints 0.593, crowded short 8.49 pctile) absorbed on the anchor Friday popped via May opex/expiry short-covering. 0504: a live up chain (Thu +1230, Fri buy-absorption close) that the blind called a spent fade carried a +440 weekend gap that persisted.
cross_cutting_finding.seam_rule_proposal_+n: When the Friday CLOSE phase shows net-sell ABSORBED by rising/holding price (ph_absorb TRUE on the close phase) AND crowded-short positioning (MM net <~15th pctile) OR a fresh multi-day up move into the weekend, flip the weekend-seam bias to UP (covering / continuation discharge) - do NOT inherit the down chain. Buy-absorption AT THE CLOSE is a directional (covering) tell, not exhaustion. This is the seam-level form of the brain's absorption doctrine.
cross_cutting_finding.reopen_read_note: The two reopens differed in gap mechanics but agreed in direction: 0427 = tiny down gap REJECTED then covering lift; 0504 = big +440 up gap PERSISTED. In both, the phase0 reopen tick was UP (+254/+140 and +247/+140) - the reopen sign, usually treated as noise, was directionally correct BOTH times and worth weighting when it aligns with a covering/absorption Friday close.
cross_cutting_finding.honest_note: Per doctrine A informs, B decides. Both flips are causally supported (observed reopen + corrected Friday exit), not fitted; magnitudes handed as bands (~+300-400 for 0427, ~+550-650 for 0504) that bracket the actuals (+370, +610) without claiming the reactive tails.
